title: Protocol
description: Annotation SOP. Defines the controlled-terminology color table that annotators paint with and the prose decision rules for ambiguous boundaries. A Protocol is referenced by Projects; updating an SOP means a new Protocol document with predecessor pointing at the old one.

description.description: Markdown SOP: scope, intended users, scan modalities, region of interest.

color_table.description: The labeled segments annotators may paint, in label-id order. Each entry binds a label integer (as written into a SEG) to a name, a display color, and a controlled-terminology code.

label.description: Label integer used in the segmentation pixel data. 0 is reserved for background.

name.description: Human-readable name shown in the Slicer UI.

rules.description: Markdown decision rules for ambiguous boundaries: what to include, what to exclude, how to handle conflicts. Plain prose; no schema beyond 'a string'.
